signals.title: marceloabritta/personal-whatsapp-ai
signals.content: Connect your Whatsapp to Evolution API and you have an AI secretary linked to your own frontier model API keys. The project is implemented using Digital Ocean. The layout is an orchestrator called into action via a message you send in a chat ("@secretary"). The orchestrator detects the requested task and assigns to one of many task specific agents.

signals.content: The Scottish Government has selected Planet for a 7-figure award to support its nationwide agricultural transition. 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁳󠁣󠁴󠁿 This one-year agreement will deliver near-daily PlanetScope data and advanced AI analysis to the country's Agricultural and Rural Economy Directorate. The continuous monitoring data will provide critical insights to help develop sustainable food production, restore regional biodiversity, and track carbon emissions reductions at a national scale. Read the official press release here: https://t.co/fiEFki2Ctl
